documents.title: CPR commercial power resistors

field_updates.detail: +/-300 ppm/C for R >= 1.0 ohm; +/-600 ppm/C for R < 1.0 ohm. CPR05 spans 0.1 ohm to 1 kohm, so the range-wide maximum is 600.
The fusing statement is conditional; it is not a guaranteed protective-fuse rating.

p1 'POWER RATING P40 °C' CPR05 = 5 W; p1 'Operating Temperature Range °C -65 to +275'; p2 Derating figure: 100 % to 40 °C, 0 % at 275 °C (visually read). Method: Rth = (275 - 40) K / 5 W = 47 K/W. Linear derating means film/element temperature = T_amb + Rth*P reaches the endpoint on the derating line, so Rth_implied = (T_end - T_knee)/P_rated. This is the derating-implied thermal resistance on the manufacturer's (unstated) reference mounting, not a measured or board-specific value. Lower confidence: no hot-spot temperature stated; free-air radial mounting assumed by the rating, not stated.
field_updates.scope: OHM-012; rth for the OHMNI simulation model (fit to the datasheet's own data); not a guaranteed limit

remaining_open_items: Reactive parasitics remain unspecified; zero L/C is an idealized assumption, not measured package behavior.
Thermal resistance derived from rating endpoints is not an independently measured board-specific value.
Destructive-failure thresholds and timing are not characterized by the rating table.
Z300 axial and 2 W variants are not covered by CPR05.
A generic open-circuit failure at the continuous power limit is not a sourced fuse time/current curve.
